name: auto-karaoke-player
description: Offline karaoke player with React, TypeScript, Node.js and Electron

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start:desktop
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/run-browser.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/desktop.test.ts
scripts.make:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64
scripts.test:titlebar: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/titlebar.test.ts
scripts.test:audience-ui: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/audience-ui.test.ts
